newsitem.title: ITALY: BankNapoli sells Il Mattino daily - report.
newsitem.headline: BankNapoli sells Il Mattino daily - report.

text.p: The board of the foundation controlling Banco di Napoli has decided to sell the Naples daily newspaper Il Mattino to businessman Francesco Paolo Caltagirone, the monthly media magazine Prima Comunicazione said.

The Caltagirone group, through its Edime subsidiary, already runs the newspaper. Prima Comunicazione, in an extract of an article to appear in its next edition, said the total deal was worth 90 billion lire. It said the price was seven billion lire above Caltagirone's previous offer for the paper, made this summer, but nine billion lire less than requested by investment bank IMI, which was handling the sale on behalf of Banco di Napoli.
The Caltagirone group already owns Rome dailies Il Tempo and Il Messaggero.
